entries.caveat: Doubao desktop has no file-level config: paste .doubao/manual/instructions.md into the client's custom instructions
MCP lives in the client leveldb store: add each server of .doubao/manual/connectors.json via 插件 -> + 添加 -> 新建自定义连接器
Doubao skills are marketplace-only; copied files serve as reference / chat attachments
slash commands become one-file skills in the manual bundle
no importable agent format; paste persona text manually
Doubao has no memory index consumer
